source.author: rogerbukuru
source.text:
Hi guys, I’m curious is there a "Firebase" for agentic backends ?

Where, in a weekend, can one easily build or integrate agentic features without having to worry about all the infra headaches for memory, tools, data ingestion, context management, permissions, governance, auth, models?

There are tons of frameworks for all these different functions, but most cover one layer. A framework is just a library, but teams still have to own everything around it. Some have cloud offerings, but that typically means you end up with 5-10 different backends, which makes evals, permissions, and governance that much more difficult.

I’m thinking of open-sourcing a bunch of our internal infra which we have been building over the last year and a half to support exactly this whilst keeping it framework-agnostic.

So that you get the infra whilst maintaining your own loop.

Keen to hear if something like this exists.

And if this is a challenge you have experienced or are experiencing as you build agentic systems or integrate AI into your apps.
source.title: Is there a "Firebase" for agentic backends
